# ADR-3214: AWS encryption: Documented client-side encryption for extranet file 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some transfers need encryption before upload.

## Decision

Partners MAY adopt a documented client-side encryption for extranet file 6 (AWS-encryption-6) when sharing regulated files.

## Consequences

Key exchange procedures are documented.
